newsitem.title: USA: Hugo Neu ends restraining order vs Proler.
newsitem.headline: Hugo Neu ends restraining order vs Proler.

text.p: Hugo Neu Corp said on Wednesday that it has agreed to dissolve a temporary restraining order prohibiting its partner, Proler International Corp, from releasing confidential information to Schnitzer Steel Industries Inc.

The company said the agreement came after Proler and Schnitzer executed a revised confidentiality agreement that "effectively protects" Neu's joint venture interests with Proler "against actions by Schnitzer," Hugo Neu said.
Neu has three scrap metal joint ventures with Proler, which is seeking a merger with Schnitzer.

Neu, a privately-held family business, said that despite ending the restraining order, it will continue arbitration proceedings against Proler for what it says is Proler's "breach of fiduciary obligations" in Proler's agreement to merge with Schnitzer.
